source_claim: AlphaEvolve stores generated solutions with attached evaluation results and program outputs so useful prior programs can be resurfaced during evolution
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve can capture evaluator outputs/program_output payloads, redact and truncate them through strict JSON policy, emit bounded value previews, source-key and output-hash records, expose runtime.history.program_output_index, include valid output-bearing programs as a current-run resurfacing source, and query defensive current-run snapshots by exact source key or exact output hash. It does not claim durable output query tables, schema-aware output retrieval, semantic output similarity search, cross-run output indexes, full output-content ranking, or replayable output-driven sampling policy.
